# fly_app (Resource)

Manages a Fly.io application.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "fly_app" "web" {
  name = "my-app"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Application name. Must be globally unique.

### Optional

- `network` (String) Per-app private network (e.g. "vault-net"). Empty/unset places the app on the org's default network. Set at create time only.
- `org` (String) Organization slug. Defaults to the provider's org_slug.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Application ID.
